1.t: When the earth is shaken violently in its [last] quaking,

2.t: when the earth throws out its burdens,

3.t: when man cries, ‘What is happening to it?’;

4.t: on that Day, it will tell all

5.t: because your Lord will inspire it [to do so].

6.t: On that Day, people will come forward in separate groups to be shown their deeds:

7.t: whoever has done an atom’s-weight of good will see it,

8.t: but whoever has done an atom’s-weight of evil will see that.
